kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the PK definitions and the two tables; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The two-axis reading (the bioavailability-clearance axis: F, Vd, CL, and t1/2 = 0.7×Vd/CL wired together so a change in Vd or CL propagates to t1/2; the steady-state axis: 4-5 half-lives to steady state, 3.3 half-lives to 90%, and the half-life remaining decay 50/25/12.5/6.25) — KYP's synthesis of the page into one reading protocol.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the definitions and tables sequentially without a unified protocol; the framing is KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The four KYP mnemonics (FOUR TO FIVE HALF-LIVES TO STEADY STATE / 0.7 × Vd / CL = t1/2 / LOW Vd = DIALYZABLE, HIGH Vd = NOT / PHASE I FALLS, PHASE II PRESERVED IN THE ELDERLY) — the page prints no margin mnemonic; all four codes are KYP's design.
kypExtensions.rationale: No mnemonic prints verbatim on book 229; all four codes are KYP-original.

notes: Census (pdfimages + VLM): NO raster images on the page (pdfimages -list returned zero rows for pdf 251). The page has ONE vector figure — the AUC (plasma concentration vs time) plot showing the IV and Oral curves with the bioavailability formula F = [AUCoral × DoseIV] / [Doseoral × AUCIV] × 100 — plus THREE text tables: the Vd compartment / drug-types table, the half-life remaining table (1 → 50%, 2 → 25%, 3 → 12.5%, 4 → 6.25%), and the age-related PK changes list (Absorption / Distribution / Metabolism / Excretion). The visual is an ORIGINAL KYP REDRAW of the AUC plot (vector graphic, no photograph). The two tables are pure text and are carried verbatim in the note's table blocks (ORIGINAL_KYP_ADAPTATION). No copyrighted photographs exist on the page; nothing reproduced. The KYP memory layer is original (no mnemonics print on book 229; all four KYP mnemonics are original designs).
